title: Alur Kolaborasi Internal (Portal Kolaborasi): Channel -> Pesan -> Thread -> Reaksi/Pin -> DM -> Unread/Search -> Pengumuman
description: Alur bisnis kritikal komunikasi internal tim (Portal Kolaborasi / Communication Hub, moduleId collab-communication). Karyawan membuat CHANNEL (public/private/department) berisi beberapa anggota, mengirim PESAN, membalas dalam THREAD (Slack-style), memberi REAKSI emoji, meng-EDIT/PIN pesan, dan mengirim DIRECT MESSAGE (DM 1:1). Sistem melacak UNREAD per channel/DM via read-receipt, menyediakan PENCARIAN konten, serta presence (online users) melalui WebSocket. Selain chat, sisi PENGUMUMAN (announcement board) memungkinkan HR mempublikasikan pengumuman ke Portal Selector/portal tertentu. Guardrail: channel tanpa nama ditolak, pesan kosong ditolak, reaksi tanpa emoji ditolak, reply pada thread-reply ditolak, edit pesan oleh non-pemilik ditolak, update channel oleh non-creator/non-admin ditolak, dan pembuatan pengumuman oleh non-HR ditolak.
happy_path_steps: Buat channel (public, member A+B) -> id channel, type=public
List + detail + update channel (deskripsi persisted); lihat member
Kirim pesan channel -> id pesan; list feed memuat pesan
Reaksi emoji, edit pesan (edited=true), pin -> pinned list -> unpin
DM: kirim ke user lain -> conversation_id; list percakapan + riwayat 2 arah
Unread per channel/DM -> mark read -> unread=0
Pengumuman: buat (HR) -> aktif -> all -> detail -> toggle
verification: backend API POC ALL PASS (tests/flow_kolaborasi_test.py: create channel -> list/detail/update -> members -> send message -> feed -> thread reply (reply_count=1) -> reaction 👍 -> edit (edited=true) -> pin/pinned/unpin -> DM send + list + riwayat 2 arah -> unread -> mark read -> unread=0 -> search + online-users -> announcement create(201)/active/all/detail/toggle; 7 guardrail: channel tanpa nama 400, pesan kosong 400, reaksi tanpa emoji 400, reply-on-reply 400, edit non-owner 403, update channel non-creator 403, announcement non-HR 403); audit_testids LULUS (0 FAIL); E2E UI PASS (Communication Hub render + sidebar Channels/Pesan Langsung + presence Online via WebSocket, verified screenshot tool); DB pristine (self-cleanup channel/pesan/percakapan/receipt/pengumuman/user).
